# ERP-Top

> Comprehensive SAP table reference and documentation hub for consultants and key-users across all major ERP modules.

ERP-Top provides detailed SAP table references and module documentation to support consultants and key-users in their daily work. The site covers all major SAP modules including Financial Accounting, Controlling, Sales & Distribution, Materials Management, and specialized areas like Real Estate Management and Quality Management.

## Key Topics

- SAP
- S/4HANA
- SAP Tables
- Financial Accounting (FI)
- Controlling (CO)
- Materials Management (MM)
- Sales & Distribution (SD)
- General Ledger
- ACDOCA
- SE16/SE16N
- Database Reference
- Master Data Tables
- Transactional Data
- Plant Maintenance
- Quality Management

- [The most important SAP tables in Accounts Payable FI-AP.](https://erp-top.com/financial-accounting/accounts-payable): SAP Accounts Payable FI-AP module table reference documentation
- [The most important SAP tables in Banks FI-BL.](https://erp-top.com/financial-accounting/banks): SAP Banks FI-BL module table reference guide
